parameters.name: Entrusted
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to entrust the lifecycle of a manually added ECS instance to the scaling group. Valid values:

- true: Entrusted. The lifecycle of the instance is managed by Auto Scaling, the same as instances of automatic creation in the scaling group. The instance is subject to automatic release when removed from the scaling group (excluding instances removed by invoking the DetachInstances operation).
- false: Not entrusted. The instance is not released when removed from the scaling group.

> This parameter is supported only for instances manually added to the scaling group, not for instances created within the scaling group.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS instance in the scaling group.
